## Who We Are

With over 40 years of expertise and experience in the development and implementation of medical
technologies in global markets, DirexGroup is a leader in shockwave therapy for multiple medical
implications, now introducing the next generation shockwave technology impacting patients’ lives.

Originating with one of the earliest lithotripters in the 1980s, our legacy includes many novel
developments, such as the introduction of Linear Shockwave Technology and, more recently, the
breakthrough ‘Morenova’ family of therapy systems. Today, our product portfolio spans diverse
treatment fields, reflecting our commitment to advancing healthcare worldwide.

[ Read more ][66]

## Morenova: Low-Intensity Solutions

Discover Morenova,  our groundbreaking LISWT (low-intensity shockwave therapy) technology, offering
safe, affordable, and pain-free treatment solutions across various applications.

[ What makes our technology so unique? ][67]

### Women's Health

Treat women’s health concerns such as vaginal pain, urinary incontinence, and sexual dysfunction

[ Read More ][68]

### Men's Health

From Erectile Dysfunction to Peyronie’s Disease and Chronic Pelvic Pain, Morenova offers men a
non-invasive treatment option to improve sexual function and overall well-being

[ Read More ][69]

### Vascular Disease

Morenova’s low-intensity shockwave therapy can be used to stimulate the growth of new blood vessels,
improving circulation and providing relief to patients

[ Read More ][70]

### Kidney Disease

Morenova provides a non-surgical, breakthrough shockwave therapy treatment for Chronic Kidney
Disease

[ Read More ][71]

### Alopecia

Address alopecia and promote hair growth with a safe, non-invasive solution for individuals
experiencing hair loss

[ Read More ][72]

### Esthetics

From cellulite reduction to skin rejuvenation, Morenova offers aesthetic treatments that enhance
skin texture and appearance

[ Read More ][73]

### Musculoskeletal Disorders

Provide relief from chronic pain, improve mobility, and promote tissue healing to address
musculoskeletal diseases such as chronic pain, tendonitis, and muscle injuries.

[ Read More ][74]

## High-Energy Solutions

### Duet Magna

Leveraging electromagnetic technology and a dual shockwave approach, Duet Magna offers distinct
advantages in shockwave lithotripsy.

### Integra

Integra integrates cutting-edge shockwave technology, advanced imaging, and a comprehensive
architecture for optimized fragmentation and precise imaging, all in a single unit.

### Renova

The first dedicated shockwave system for Erectile Dysfunction treatment, offering Linear Shockwave
Therapy for full organ coverage and shorter treatment protocols.

the non-cancerous enlargement of the prostate gland in aging men. As the prostate enlarges, it can
squeeze down on the urethra.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

# Your next dream job is here

Hirify is a job board and meta-aggregator of the best IT and Digital jobs.  Why Hirify is different
* We collect directly from career pages - we take vacancies straight from company sites, including
  custom career sites other aggregators do not reach.
* Updated every 2 hours - we cycle through our sources continuously, so new vacancies often appear
  here before they do on other platforms, including the big ones.
* Deduplication across 960+ Telegram channels - catches around 90% of duplicates, so the same job
  posted across dozens of channels usually does not repeat in your feed. We match title and company,
  contacts, vector similarity, and AI checks the borderline pairs.
* Smart filter - 15+ parameters (specialization, stack, domain, English, format, company type, geo),
  each with an exclude mode. You can also build the filter just by typing - AI parses a
  plain-language request.
* Telegram alerts - save as many filters as you want and get notified across all of them.
  Deduplication works here too: if a vacancy matches several of your filters, it arrives once, not
  as duplicates.

### **A Comprehensive Guide to Erectile Dysfunction**

Erectile dysfunction (ED) is a common condition that affects millions of men worldwide. While it can
be a sensitive topic, understanding its causes, treatments, and the importance of seeking help is
the first step toward regaining control and confidence. This guide provides in-depth information to
help you navigate your journey to better sexual health.

#### **1. Understanding the Root Causes of ED**

Erectile dysfunction is more than just a physical issue; it's often a complex interplay of physical
and psychological factors. Physically, it can be an early warning sign of more serious health
problems. Conditions like heart disease, atherosclerosis (clogged blood vessels), high cholesterol,
high blood pressure, and diabetes are leading causes because they restrict blood flow to the penis,
which is essential for an erection. Neurological disorders, such as Parkinson's disease or multiple
sclerosis, can also interfere with the nerve signals required for an erection. Hormonal imbalances,
particularly low testosterone, can contribute to ED, although this is less common. On the
psychological side, stress, anxiety, and depression are significant contributors. Performance
anxiety can create a vicious cycle where a single instance of ED leads to fear of future failures,
exacerbating the problem. Relationship problems and other life stressors also play a crucial role.
It's vital to consult a healthcare provider to identify the specific causes in your case, as this
will determine the most effective treatment path.

#### **2. Oral Medications for ED: How They Work**

For many men, oral medications known as phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5) inhibitors are a highly
effective first-line treatment. These drugs, including Sildenafil (Viagra), Tadalafil (Cialis), and
Vardenafil (Levitra), work by enhancing the effects of nitric oxide, a natural chemical the body
produces to relax muscles in the penis. This relaxation allows for increased blood flow, which helps
produce an erection in response to sexual stimulation. It's important to understand that these pills
do not automatically cause an erection; sexual arousal is still necessary. Each medication has a
slightly different chemical structure, which affects how quickly it works and how long its effects
last. For example, Tadalafil can remain effective for up to 36 hours, earning it the nickname "the
weekend pill," while Sildenafil and Vardenafil typically work for about four to five hours. A doctor
will help you choose the right medication based on your health profile, lifestyle, and preferences.
These drugs are prescription-only for a reason—they can have side effects and interact with other
medications, particularly nitrates used for chest pain, which can cause a dangerous drop in blood
pressure.

#### **3. The Powerful Role of Lifestyle Changes**

While medication can be very effective, lifestyle modifications are a cornerstone of managing and
sometimes even reversing erectile dysfunction. Think of your overall health as the foundation for
your sexual health. Regular physical activity is one of the most impactful changes you can make.
Aerobic exercise, like brisk walking, swimming, or cycling, improves cardiovascular health and blood
flow throughout the body, including to the penis. A heart-healthy diet, rich in fruits, vegetables,
whole grains, and lean proteins, can help manage weight, lower cholesterol, and improve vascular
function. Quitting smoking is critical, as smoking damages blood vessels and impairs circulation.
Similarly, reducing alcohol consumption can make a significant difference, as excessive alcohol
intake is a known contributor to ED. Managing stress through techniques like mindfulness,
meditation, or yoga can also address the psychological components of the condition. These changes
not only improve erectile function but also enhance overall well-being, reduce the risk of other
chronic diseases, and can make medical treatments more effective. They empower you to take an active
role in your health journey.

### **A Comprehensive Guide to Erectile Dysfunction**

Erectile dysfunction (ED) is a common condition that affects millions of men worldwide. While it can
be a sensitive topic, understanding its causes, treatments, and the importance of seeking help is
the first step toward regaining control and confidence. This guide provides in-depth information to
help you navigate your journey to better sexual health.

#### **1. Understanding the Root Causes of ED**

Erectile dysfunction is more than just a physical issue; it's often a complex interplay of physical
and psychological factors. Physically, it can be an early warning sign of more serious health
problems. Conditions like heart disease, atherosclerosis (clogged blood vessels), high cholesterol,
high blood pressure, and diabetes are leading causes because they restrict blood flow to the penis,
which is essential for an erection. Neurological disorders, such as Parkinson's disease or multiple
sclerosis, can also interfere with the nerve signals required for an erection. Hormonal imbalances,
particularly low testosterone, can contribute to ED, although this is less common. On the
psychological side, stress, anxiety, and depression are significant contributors. Performance
anxiety can create a vicious cycle where a single instance of ED leads to fear of future failures,
exacerbating the problem. Relationship problems and other life stressors also play a crucial role.
It's vital to consult a healthcare provider to identify the specific causes in your case, as this
will determine the most effective treatment path.

#### **2. Oral Medications for ED: How They Work**

For many men, oral medications known as phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5) inhibitors are a highly
effective first-line treatment. These drugs, including Sildenafil (Viagra), Tadalafil (Cialis), and
Vardenafil (Levitra), work by enhancing the effects of nitric oxide, a natural chemical the body
produces to relax muscles in the penis. This relaxation allows for increased blood flow, which helps
produce an erection in response to sexual stimulation. It's important to understand that these pills
do not automatically cause an erection; sexual arousal is still necessary. Each medication has a
slightly different chemical structure, which affects how quickly it works and how long its effects
last. For example, Tadalafil can remain effective for up to 36 hours, earning it the nickname "the
weekend pill," while Sildenafil and Vardenafil typically work for about four to five hours. A doctor
will help you choose the right medication based on your health profile, lifestyle, and preferences.
These drugs are prescription-only for a reason—they can have side effects and interact with other
medications, particularly nitrates used for chest pain, which can cause a dangerous drop in blood
pressure.

#### **3. The Powerful Role of Lifestyle Changes**

While medication can be very effective, lifestyle modifications are a cornerstone of managing and
sometimes even reversing erectile dysfunction. Think of your overall health as the foundation for
your sexual health. Regular physical activity is one of the most impactful changes you can make.
Aerobic exercise, like brisk walking, swimming, or cycling, improves cardiovascular health and blood
flow throughout the body, including to the penis. A heart-healthy diet, rich in fruits, vegetables,
whole grains, and lean proteins, can help manage weight, lower cholesterol, and improve vascular
function. Quitting smoking is critical, as smoking damages blood vessels and impairs circulation.
Similarly, reducing alcohol consumption can make a significant difference, as excessive alcohol
intake is a known contributor to ED. Managing stress through techniques like mindfulness,
meditation, or yoga can also address the psychological components of the condition. These changes
not only improve erectile function but also enhance overall well-being, reduce the risk of other
chronic diseases, and can make medical treatments more effective. They empower you to take an active
role in your health journey.

#### **4. When to Consult a Doctor About ED**

Many men feel embarrassed to talk about erectile dysfunction, but seeking medical advice is a
crucial step for your health and well-being. You should consider seeing a doctor if you experience
persistent trouble getting or keeping an erection firm enough for sex. Occasional difficulties are
normal, but when it becomes a regular occurrence, it's time to get it checked out. A doctor's visit
is important for several reasons. First, a healthcare professional can perform a thorough
evaluation, including a physical exam and possibly blood tests, to identify the underlying cause of
your ED. As mentioned, ED can be a symptom of serious conditions like heart disease or diabetes, and
early diagnosis can lead to life-saving interventions. Second, a doctor can provide a safe and
effective treatment plan tailored to you. Self-treating with supplements or medications purchased
online can be dangerous, as these products may be ineffective, contain harmful ingredients, or cause
dangerous interactions with other drugs. A professional can prescribe proven, regulated medications
and monitor you for side effects. Finally, talking to a doctor can provide reassurance and help
address any psychological factors, like anxiety, that may be contributing to the problem. It's a
confidential, professional conversation aimed at improving your quality of life.

#### **5. Exploring Alternative ED Treatments**

When oral medications are not effective or suitable, there are several other proven treatments for
erectile dysfunction. One common alternative is a vacuum erection device (VED). This device consists
of a plastic cylinder placed over the penis, a pump (either manual or battery-operated), and a
constriction ring. The pump creates a vacuum, which draws blood into the penis, causing an erection.

Evidence-based outcomes, backed by science, shaped by data & grounded in clinical rigor. Doctor-led
studies. Peer-reviewed journal publications, real-world results.

MV Devices are based on decades of clinical research demonstrating that targeted vibration therapy
can treat erectile dysfunction and support arousal and intimate wellness.

## Making Uro/Gyn Healthcare
## Accessible To All

Delivering effective Uro/Gyn care at scale means removing friction from both the supply chain and
the patient journey. We create medical-grade, at-home devices that tackle sexual dysfunction with
high clinical efficacy, offering a reliable, non-invasive alternative to traditional pharmaceutical
treatments.

Our operational infrastructure is designed for mass adoption, ensuring that our evidence-based
therapies can reach patients efficiently & cost-effectively, no matter where they are seeking care.

Global Distribution
Trusted by major medical device distributors across the US and internationally.
Seamless Integration
Built to plug directly into existing telehealth workflows, hospital systems & corporate wellness
platforms.
End-to-End Support
Fully supported by comprehensive clinical training, frictionless patient onboarding & dedicated
educational materials.

Located in the heart of Reading, Berkshire, The Forbury Clinic offers private, high-standard medical
services in a comfortable and welcoming environment. Established in 2011, our clinic is designed to
provide exceptional healthcare while ensuring your privacy and comfort.

At The Forbury Clinic, we focus on delivering personalised care with professionalism and empathy. We
understand that each patient is unique, and our services are tailored to meet your individual needs.
Our team includes some of the best [Urology][82], [ENT][83], [Ultrasound, ][84][Ophthalmology][85]
and [Coloproctology][86] specialists in the country, all committed to providing the highest standard
of patient care.

We operate from two convenient locations, ‘[The Forbury Clinic – Kendrick Road][87]’ and ‘[The
Forbury Clinic – Craven Road][88],’ both designed to support your health and recovery. Experience
the difference that our private healthcare can make in your life.

## About The Forbury Clinic

Welcome to The Forbury Clinic, where cutting-edge medical care meets unparalleled patient support
within the heart of Reading. We are committed to revolutionising patient outcomes through our
dedicated approach to specialised care in [Urology][89], [ENT][90], [Ophthalmology][91],
[Ultrasound,][92] [Dermatology,][93] [Coloproctology,][94] [Blood][95] & [Genetic Testing.][96]

Our dedicated team of healthcare professionals and consultants brings deep experience and a shared
commitment to improving patients’ lives. Using the latest medical technology and proven treatments,
we make sure each patient receives high-quality, personalised care.

We pride ourselves on our patient-centred approach. Understanding that each patient’s journey is
unique, we strive to provide an environment that is not just healing but also empowering. From our
state-of-the-art facilities to our supportive and compassionate staff, every aspect of our clinic is
designed with your health, comfort, and wellbeing in mind.

Our mission is clear: to deliver world-class healthcare solutions across a variety of
specialisations, ensuring that you have access to the best possible treatment options. Whether
you’re seeking comprehensive diagnostics, innovative treatments, or expert advice, The Forbury
Clinic is here to support you every step of the way.

Discover a partner in your healthcare journey at The Forbury Clinic – where your health is our
highest priority, and your recovery, our greatest achievement.

# Did you know?

Vacuum Therapy is the only natural, drug free treatment for erectile dysfunction proven to be over
90% effective. More than half of men over 40 have some degree of ED
* ### What is ED?
  
  Erectile dysfunction, or ED, is when it is hard to get or keep an erection that's firm enough for
  sex. ED affects as many as 40 million men.
  
  [Read More][51]
* ### What Causes ED?
  
  ED can result from health or emotional problems or from both. Lower blood flow or harm to nerves
  in the penis can lead to erection problems.
  
  [Read More][52]
* ### How to treat ED?
  
  The treatment for ED depends on what is causing it. Your health care provider may ask you to
  change certain habits, stop smoking, or using drugs or alcohol.
  
  [Read More][53]

Erectile Dysfunction (ED) is a common debilitating condition and one that often dramatically
diminishes quality of life. Unysen Health is a company committed to enabling men to regain their
sexual health. For a large number of men that fail oral therapies and yet desire to continue on the
journey to sexual recovery, education and access to effective treatments is the cornerstone for
success. Our focus is the individual and his personal and unique quest for sexual recovery. Through
education, empowerment and access to quality treatments, over the counter medications and medical
devices many men will ultimately fulfill their hope of reclaiming satisfactory sexual performance.

# Did you know?

Vacuum Therapy is the only natural, drug free treatment for erectile dysfunction proven to be over
90% effective. More than half of men over 40 have some degree of ED
* ### What is ED?
  
  Erectile dysfunction, or ED, is when it is hard to get or keep an erection that's firm enough for
  sex. ED affects as many as 40 million men.
  
  [Read More][51]
* ### What Causes ED?
  
  ED can result from health or emotional problems or from both. Lower blood flow or harm to nerves
  in the penis can lead to erection problems.
  
  [Read More][52]
* ### How to treat ED?
  
  The treatment for ED depends on what is causing it. Your health care provider may ask you to
  change certain habits, stop smoking, or using drugs or alcohol.
  
  [Read More][53]

Erectile Dysfunction (ED) is a common debilitating condition and one that often dramatically
diminishes quality of life. Unysen Health is a company committed to enabling men to regain their
sexual health. For a large number of men that fail oral therapies and yet desire to continue on the
journey to sexual recovery, education and access to effective treatments is the cornerstone for
success. Our focus is the individual and his personal and unique quest for sexual recovery. Through
education, empowerment and access to quality treatments, over the counter medications and medical
devices many men will ultimately fulfill their hope of reclaiming satisfactory sexual performance.
